prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Héctor, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Word is the council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines to anyone caught with a bin on the sidewalk after 8am. They’re apparently sending inspectors out to patrol every single street, so please be extremely careful!"
text: The council is launching a massive city-wide crackdown starting tomorrow to hunt down every single bin left out. They’re sending armed inspectors to every street to issue ruinous fines, so hide your trash immediately or you will be targeted!
